name: sunpower-monitor
description: Read-only SunPower PVS6 collector, private dashboard, and Cloudflare ingest API

scripts.check: npm run build:web && npm run check:types && npm run check:units && npm run check:config && npm run check:web && npm run check:render && npm run check:preview && npm run check:site
scripts.check:config: node --test scripts/render-config.test.mjs && node scripts/github-user.mjs --check && node scripts/worker-origin.mjs --check && node scripts/cloudflare-account.mjs --check

scripts.build:site: npm run build:web && npm run check:site
